hypothesis: Distill fixed radius-2 molecular-fingerprint geometry into the frozen corpus representation: fit one task-agnostic ridge map from the Parent-equivalent mean-pooled GRU embeddings of unlabeled corpus molecules to their graph fingerprints, then publish the normalized mapped vector as the unchanged-width sequence embedding.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

method_tags.proposal_mechanism: disposable inner-policy optimization against the surrogate posterior mean followed by ancestral de novo sampling and batch acquisition from a newly generated ephemeral set

activation_observables.measurement: Using the deterministic heldout audit rows partitioned into fixed consecutive 64-molecule panels, exclude self matches and, for every row, identify its five nearest neighbors by cosine similarity under (a) the Parent-equivalent normalized mean-pooled embedding and (b) the published mapped embedding. For each neighbor set compute the mean radius-2 count-Morgan Tanimoto similarity to the anchor and its overlap with the panel's five highest-Tanimoto graph neighbors. Report the paired mapped-minus-Parent changes in pooled mean neighbor Tanimoto and graph-neighbor recall, their per-panel changes, fit and fallback counts, output width and finiteness, and maximum serialized-reload difference. Activation requires a finite nonzero fitted map used by run-mode sequence_embeddings, no width change, exact reload reproduction, and a positive pooled mapped-minus-Parent change in mean neighbor Tanimoto; graph-neighbor recall is a retained corroborating diagnostic rather than a substitute objective.
activation_observables.name: frozen_embedding_neighborhood_stability

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus must supply at least 8,192 canonical-valid connected training molecules with nonconstant radius-2 count fingerprints and recurrent embeddings of sufficient rank for a finite ridge fit; otherwise the bounded Parent-embedding fallback applies and the mechanism does not activate.

The learned corpus relation between recurrent sequence features and graph-fingerprint coordinates must generalize to the fixed heldout split and to de novo molecules sampled later from the same tokenizer and policy support.

Task reward must be locally smoother in radius-2 graph neighborhoods than in the Parent's likelihood-only recurrent geometry. Objectives dominated by global shape, stereochemistry, long-range pharmacophores, or sharp activity cliffs may not benefit even when the heldout neighborhood observable increases.

The mechanism preserves the Parent's generative logits and sampling distribution exactly at preparation time; it addresses frozen surrogate geometry, not the Parent's remaining parse failures, preparation-seed support variation, true-anchor ordering failures, or late expected-improvement collapse.

The map is fitted once from unlabeled corpus graphs without task identity or oracle labels and remains a non-parameter buffer in the prior, anchor, and disposable clones, so no online state or score can alter the representation calibration.

Unlike n-f851988d522a, this intervention keeps one canonical embedding and one real score per graph in every task-local GP table; unlike n-d3657d86652a, it learns a full graph-predictive coordinate map rather than deleting a single token-length direction.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if the corpus ridge fit is non-finite or collapses to the Parent fallback, if run-mode embeddings do not use the serialized map, if any published embedding is non-finite or changes the 512-dimensional normalized interface, if serialized reload does not reproduce the mapped heldout vectors, or if the pooled heldout mean count-Morgan similarity of mapped-embedding neighbors fails to increase over the paired Parent-equivalent neighbors. If that neighborhood quantity increases but benchmark score does not, the graph-local distillation activated but was not useful rather than failing to occur.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep the Parent's corpus reservoir and split, vocabulary, GRU architecture and parameters, five-epoch next-token training trajectory, forward logits, likelihood calculation, ancestral sampler, terminal checkpoint, support audit, artifact filenames, canonicalization, and every run-mode Layer unchanged. After Parent-identical language-model training, take the first 8,192 canonical-valid connected molecules from the deterministically shuffled training split, compute their Parent-equivalent normalized 512-dimensional mean-pooled recurrent vectors and fixed 512-coordinate radius-2 Morgan count fingerprints, and fit a single finite L2-ridge linear map with an intercept from the former to the latter. Register the fitted matrix and centering vectors as non-parameter policy buffers. Change only sequence_embeddings so it applies that frozen map to the Parent-equivalent vector, clamps predicted fingerprint coordinates to nonnegative values, and L2-normalizes the result; use the exact Parent vector as a bounded per-row fallback when the fit or mapped norm is non-finite or effectively zero. On up to 4,096 canonical-valid heldout molecules, retain paired Parent-equivalent and mapped embeddings plus graph fingerprints, audit fixed 64-molecule panels, and serialize the fit provenance and exact reload check in the existing two-file artifact. No fingerprint, corpus molecule, task identity, oracle score, randomized labeled view, or online update enters candidate generation or the task-local observation table, and the buffer never becomes an optimizer parameter.
research_intent.mechanism: Distill fixed radius-2 molecular-fingerprint geometry into the frozen corpus representation: fit one task-agnostic ridge map from the Parent-equivalent mean-pooled GRU embeddings of unlabeled corpus molecules to their graph fingerprints, then publish the normalized mapped vector as the unchanged-width sequence embedding.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf publishes a 512-dimensional embedding obtained by uniformly mean-pooling recurrent states trained only for next-token likelihood, so its exact GP receives no corpus-level pressure for graph-local molecular neighborhoods. Although all 450 Parent fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation, 130 of 435 disposable-clone updates reduce paired posterior-mean reward, and sitagliptin_mpo has pooled lift only 0.00011006466612005493. Representation-only node n-d3657d86652a further shows that changing this frozen geometry can matter, with a +0.02482218848232635 mean paired score change, but its one-axis length deletion regresses seed 2 and two task means, so indiscriminate nuisance removal is not stable enough. Node n-f851988d522a instead reduced in-table graph-equivalent posterior disagreement by repeating five labeled views, yet lowered seed-0 macro score by 0.15944257826084401 and weakened acquisition pressure. The limiting behavior is therefore a frozen representation whose distances are not explicitly trained to preserve unlabeled graph neighborhoods, not missing observation assimilation or a need for repeated labeled views.

applicability_conditions: Activation is supported for the evaluated 250,000-record corpus reservoirs, 245,904-row training splits, canonical tokenizer, five-epoch Parent-identical GRU states, and preparation seeds 0 through 2. Each supplied 8,192 aligned canonical-valid connected training molecules and all 512 nonconstant radius-2 fingerprint coordinates needed for a finite nonzero ridge fit.

Heldout transfer is supported on 12,287 eligible deterministic rows under fixed consecutive 64-row panels and five neighbors per row. All three pooled Tanimoto deltas are positive, and every one of 192 panel-level Tanimoto and corroborating recall deltas is positive.

Artifact and downstream interface compatibility is supported at fixed width 512: reload is bit-exact for all heldout vectors, the map remains in nonparameter buffers, all 15 fresh objective sessions explicitly report the map active with zero fingerprint parameters, and every task completes its 300-call budget.

The corpus-only boundary is supported by the implementation and artifacts: fingerprint fitting occurs once after Parent-identical language-model training, uses only canonical corpus graphs and frozen recurrent features, and the resulting state is copied unchanged into prior, anchor, and disposable-clone models. No task identity or oracle score enters the fit.

Useful score transfer is not supported in aggregate for this Hard-Five evaluation. Applicability as an optimization improvement additionally requires a task whose reward is smoother in radius-2 graph neighborhoods than in the Parent recurrent geometry; the negative mean score change and mixed task means show that this condition cannot be assumed from the heldout graph audit alone.

The evidence applies to one canonical embedding per graph and fixed 512-coordinate radius-2 count fingerprints. It does not establish benefits for stereochemistry-sensitive, global-shape, long-range-pharmacophore, activity-cliff, or out-of-corpus objectives, nor for another fingerprint radius, hashing dimension, corpus, tokenizer, or global-neighbor audit.

A future preparation remains applicable only if it supplies the full 8,192 aligned rows, nonconstant finite targets and sufficiently ranked recurrent features for a finite ridge solution, and if mapped norms remain finite and above the threshold on downstream molecules. The bounded Parent fallback exists but was not exercised by these replicas.

possible_failure_causes: The graph-local intermediate behavior improved strongly, but the expected benchmark score increase did not occur. Candidate val_scores 0.527024575586678, 0.54463979106872, and 0.550303760457056 compare with paired Parent scores 0.513626533890974, 0.558308002112387, and 0.575798548411393, giving seedwise changes +0.013398041695704022, -0.013668211043667, and -0.025494787954337017 and a mean change -0.008588319100766665. This is a confirmed but score-negative activation, exactly the Research Intent's Knowledge-only case, rather than evidence that the map failed to run.

Score transfer is task dependent. Candidate-minus-Parent task-mean changes are -0.1036765381917929 on zaleplon_mpo, +0.01658933049041733 on deco_hop, +0.0019155191443958053 on drd2_docking, -0.01052639924569787 on median_2, and +0.05275649229884491 on sitagliptin_mpo. Radius-2 graph locality is therefore not a universal proxy for the reward surfaces, and the large zaleplon regression dominates the otherwise mixed task evidence.

The heldout audit establishes generalization only to deterministic corpus rows under the same canonical tokenizer and preparation distribution. Although all 15 task sessions used the map, the receipts do not recompute graph-neighbor quality on de novo clone samples or show that mapped neighborhoods remain stable after search moves into a different chemical region.

The audit restricts neighbor competition to consecutive 64-molecule panels. The intervention improves all 192 observed panels, which makes a panel-specific sign accident unlikely in these replicas, but the evidence does not measure global nearest neighbors over the full heldout set or robustness to a different panel partition.

The 512-coordinate hashed radius-2 count-Morgan target emphasizes local connectivity and can collide features or omit stereochemistry, global shape, long-range pharmacophores, and activity cliffs. The learned geometry may therefore become more faithful to this proxy while discarding sequence-representation directions useful for particular rewards.

The ridge fit and per-row fallback guards were operational but the fallback was never exercised: all 24,576 training predictions and all 12,287 heldout predictions mapped successfully. These replicas therefore establish the active-map path, not empirical behavior for a future corpus with insufficient aligned rows, constant fingerprints, a non-positive-definite system, nonfinite coefficients, or a near-zero unseen mapped norm.

Published sequence_embeddings and a separately batched direct map differ by at most 6.537884473800659e-07, while serialized reload is bit-exact at 0.0. The small first quantity is compatible with floating-point batching order and does not trigger the registered reload falsifier, but applications requiring bitwise equality across different batching shapes are not established.

Seed 0 supplies 4,095 rather than 4,096 audit rows because one heldout molecule failed the fixed size filter; its last panel has 63 rows. The pooled calculation correctly retains that denominator, but transfer to corpora with materially more filtering or smaller final panels is not shown.

Each supplied 8,192 aligned canonical-valid connected training molecules and all 512 nonconstant radius-2 fingerprint coordinates needed for a finite nonzero ridge fit.

Heldout transfer is supported on 12,287 eligible deterministic rows under fixed consecutive 64-row panels and five neighbors per row. All three pooled Tanimoto deltas are positive, and every one of 192 panel-level Tanimoto and corroborating recall deltas is positive.

Artifact and downstream interface compatibility is supported at fixed width 512: reload is bit-exact for all heldout vectors, the map remains in nonparameter buffers, all 15 fresh objective sessions explicitly report the map active with zero fingerprint parameters, and every task completes its 300-call budget.

The corpus-only boundary is supported by the implementation and artifacts: fingerprint fitting occurs once after Parent-identical language-model training, uses only canonical corpus graphs and frozen recurrent features, and the resulting state is copied unchanged into prior, anchor, and disposable-clone models. No task identity or oracle score enters the fit.

Useful score transfer is not supported in aggregate for this Hard-Five evaluation. Applicability as an optimization improvement additionally requires a task whose reward is smoother in radius-2 graph neighborhoods than in the Parent recurrent geometry; the negative mean score change and mixed task means show that this condition cannot be assumed from the heldout graph audit alone.

The evidence applies to one canonical embedding per graph and fixed 512-coordinate radius-2 count fingerprints. It does not establish benefits for stereochemistry-sensitive, global-shape, long-range-pharmacophore, activity-cliff, or out-of-corpus objectives, nor for another fingerprint radius, hashing dimension, corpus, tokenizer, or global-neighbor audit.

A future preparation remains applicable only if it supplies the full 8,192 aligned rows, nonconstant finite targets and sufficiently ranked recurrent features for a finite ridge solution, and if mapped norms remain finite and above the threshold on downstream molecules. The bounded Parent fallback exists but was not exercised by these replicas.

possible_failure_causes: The graph-local intermediate behavior improved strongly, but the expected benchmark score increase did not occur. Candidate val_scores 0.527024575586678, 0.54463979106872, and 0.550303760457056 compare with paired Parent scores 0.513626533890974, 0.558308002112387, and 0.575798548411393, giving seedwise changes +0.013398041695704022, -0.013668211043667, and -0.025494787954337017 and a mean change -0.008588319100766665. This is a confirmed but score-negative activation, exactly the Research Intent's Knowledge-only case, rather than evidence that the map failed to run.

Score transfer is task dependent. Candidate-minus-Parent task-mean changes are -0.1036765381917929 on zaleplon_mpo, +0.01658933049041733 on deco_hop, +0.0019155191443958053 on drd2_docking, -0.01052639924569787 on median_2, and +0.05275649229884491 on sitagliptin_mpo. Radius-2 graph locality is therefore not a universal proxy for the reward surfaces, and the large zaleplon regression dominates the otherwise mixed task evidence.

The heldout audit establishes generalization only to deterministic corpus rows under the same canonical tokenizer and preparation distribution. Although all 15 task sessions used the map, the receipts do not recompute graph-neighbor quality on de novo clone samples or show that mapped neighborhoods remain stable after search moves into a different chemical region.

The audit restricts neighbor competition to consecutive 64-molecule panels. The intervention improves all 192 observed panels, which makes a panel-specific sign accident unlikely in these replicas, but the evidence does not measure global nearest neighbors over the full heldout set or robustness to a different panel partition.

The 512-coordinate hashed radius-2 count-Morgan target emphasizes local connectivity and can collide features or omit stereochemistry, global shape, long-range pharmacophores, and activity cliffs. The learned geometry may therefore become more faithful to this proxy while discarding sequence-representation directions useful for particular rewards.

The ridge fit and per-row fallback guards were operational but the fallback was never exercised: all 24,576 training predictions and all 12,287 heldout predictions mapped successfully. These replicas therefore establish the active-map path, not empirical behavior for a future corpus with insufficient aligned rows, constant fingerprints, a non-positive-definite system, nonfinite coefficients, or a near-zero unseen mapped norm.

Published sequence_embeddings and a separately batched direct map differ by at most 6.537884473800659e-07, while serialized reload is bit-exact at 0.0. The small first quantity is compatible with floating-point batching order and does not trigger the registered reload falsifier, but applications requiring bitwise equality across different batching shapes are not established.

For each neighbor set compute the mean radius-2 count-Morgan Tanimoto similarity to the anchor and its overlap with the panel's five highest-Tanimoto graph neighbors. Report the paired mapped-minus-Parent changes in pooled mean neighbor Tanimoto and graph-neighbor recall, their per-panel changes, fit and fallback counts, output width and finiteness, and maximum serialized-reload difference. Activation requires a finite nonzero fitted map used by run-mode sequence_embeddings, no width change, exact reload reproduction, and a positive pooled mapped-minus-Parent change in mean neighbor Tanimoto; graph-neighbor recall is a retained corroborating diagnostic rather than a substitute objective.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus must supply at least 8,192 canonical-valid connected training molecules with nonconstant radius-2 count fingerprints and recurrent embeddings of sufficient rank for a finite ridge fit; otherwise the bounded Parent-embedding fallback applies and the mechanism does not activate.

The learned corpus relation between recurrent sequence features and graph-fingerprint coordinates must generalize to the fixed heldout split and to de novo molecules sampled later from the same tokenizer and policy support.

Task reward must be locally smoother in radius-2 graph neighborhoods than in the Parent's likelihood-only recurrent geometry. Objectives dominated by global shape, stereochemistry, long-range pharmacophores, or sharp activity cliffs may not benefit even when the heldout neighborhood observable increases.

The mechanism preserves the Parent's generative logits and sampling distribution exactly at preparation time; it addresses frozen surrogate geometry, not the Parent's remaining parse failures, preparation-seed support variation, true-anchor ordering failures, or late expected-improvement collapse.

The map is fitted once from unlabeled corpus graphs without task identity or oracle labels and remains a non-parameter buffer in the prior, anchor, and disposable clones, so no online state or score can alter the representation calibration.

Unlike n-f851988d522a, this intervention keeps one canonical embedding and one real score per graph in every task-local GP table; unlike n-d3657d86652a, it learns a full graph-predictive coordinate map rather than deleting a single token-length direction.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if the corpus ridge fit is non-finite or collapses to the Parent fallback, if run-mode embeddings do not use the serialized map, if any published embedding is non-finite or changes the 512-dimensional normalized interface, if serialized reload does not reproduce the mapped heldout vectors, or if the pooled heldout mean count-Morgan similarity of mapped-embedding neighbors fails to increase over the paired Parent-equivalent neighbors. If that neighborhood quantity increases but benchmark score does not, the graph-local distillation activated but was not useful rather than failing to occur.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep the Parent's corpus reservoir and split, vocabulary, GRU architecture and parameters, five-epoch next-token training trajectory, forward logits, likelihood calculation, ancestral sampler, terminal checkpoint, support audit, artifact filenames, canonicalization, and every run-mode Layer unchanged. After Parent-identical language-model training, take the first 8,192 canonical-valid connected molecules from the deterministically shuffled training split, compute their Parent-equivalent normalized 512-dimensional mean-pooled recurrent vectors and fixed 512-coordinate radius-2 Morgan count fingerprints, and fit a single finite L2-ridge linear map with an intercept from the former to the latter. Register the fitted matrix and centering vectors as non-parameter policy buffers. Change only sequence_embeddings so it applies that frozen map to the Parent-equivalent vector, clamps predicted fingerprint coordinates to nonnegative values, and L2-normalizes the result; use the exact Parent vector as a bounded per-row fallback when the fit or mapped norm is non-finite or effectively zero. On up to 4,096 canonical-valid heldout molecules, retain paired Parent-equivalent and mapped embeddings plus graph fingerprints, audit fixed 64-molecule panels, and serialize the fit provenance and exact reload check in the existing two-file artifact. No fingerprint, corpus molecule, task identity, oracle score, randomized labeled view, or online update enters candidate generation or the task-local observation table, and the buffer never becomes an optimizer parameter.
research_intent.mechanism: Distill fixed radius-2 molecular-fingerprint geometry into the frozen corpus representation: fit one task-agnostic ridge map from the Parent-equivalent mean-pooled GRU embeddings of unlabeled corpus molecules to their graph fingerprints, then publish the normalized mapped vector as the unchanged-width sequence embedding.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf publishes a 512-dimensional embedding obtained by uniformly mean-pooling recurrent states trained only for next-token likelihood, so its exact GP receives no corpus-level pressure for graph-local molecular neighborhoods. Although all 450 Parent fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation, 130 of 435 disposable-clone updates reduce paired posterior-mean reward, and sitagliptin_mpo has pooled lift only 0.00011006466612005493. Representation-only node n-d3657d86652a further shows that changing this frozen geometry can matter, with a +0.02482218848232635 mean paired score change, but its one-axis length deletion regresses seed 2 and two task means, so indiscriminate nuisance removal is not stable enough. Node n-f851988d522a instead reduced in-table graph-equivalent posterior disagreement by repeating five labeled views, yet lowered seed-0 macro score by 0.15944257826084401 and weakened acquisition pressure. The limiting behavior is therefore a frozen representation whose distances are not explicitly trained to preserve unlabeled graph neighborhoods, not missing observation assimilation or a need for repeated labeled views.
